item.text: The stated `Q2 = -0.5 GeV²` fails EXCLURAD’s input convention: its `Q2` field is the positive spacelike virtuality, \(Q^2=-q^2\). I’m treating the minus sign as the common \(q^2\) convention and validating the corrected EXCLURAD value `Q2 = +0.5 GeV²`; this correction will be recorded explicitly.

The corrected point passes all preflight checks using the η defaults (beam energy 6.53 GeV and \(v_\text{cut}=0.166\ \mathrm{GeV}^2\)). The input generator produced one EXCLURAD file plus its manifest; I’m now recording the correction and generated filenames in the required outcome.
